entries.target: A short range skill that heals yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Recovers HP and surrounds yourself in a magical shield of fire. Applies Burning Ward for 6 seconds, reducing your incoming damage by 50% while also causing any foe who strike you while it's active to take damage, capped at 1,000 per hit. If Scorch is active on your target, they receive double damage and the cap is increased to 2,000.
